items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: We had George Lewis on the clarinet. I played sax and George Lewis on the clarinet.

ctx.x: Yeah, Chester playing bass. We had some, some, some, Thomas playing banjo. We had Edna Mitchell. We called Edna Francis. We married that boy. Edna Mitchell playing piano. You know Albert Francis, his wife. She had up playing piano. And I was on the clarinet. And I was on the saxophone. We had George Lewis on the clarinet. I played sax and George Lewis on the clarinet. And then after they had, who had played? We had Morris French playing primal. I'm making a note here about Albert Francis' wife. Edna Mitchell.…
